edges.reason: numberOfTokens parameter controls how many tokens mint() attempts to create.
mint() uses msg.sender as the recipient of _safeMint.
withdraw() forwards the contract balance to msg.sender.
reserveNFTs() mints reserved tokens to msg.sender.
mint() reads block.timestamp to enforce the minting window.
block.timestamp feeds the timestamp gate checks in mint().
mint() executes timestamp-dependent require statements.
mint() performs SafeMath add/mul on numberOfTokens and supply counters.
withdraw() performs the msg.sender.transfer value call.
msg.sender is the recipient of the transferred balance.
MAX_NFTS bounds the supply check inside mint().
mintPrice is used to validate msg.value in mint().
maxPurchase caps numberOfTokens in mint().
START_MINT gates when mint() can be called.
MINT_KEEP_SEC bounds how long mint() remains callable.
mint() writes startingIndexBlock once the collection sells out.
setStartingIndex() reads startingIndexBlock as the blockhash seed.
setStartingIndex() derives the reveal index from blockhash values.
setStartingIndex() checks that startingIndex is still unset.
setStartingIndex() writes the computed startingIndex.
MAX_NFTS is used as the modulo bound in setStartingIndex().
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock() writes startingIndexBlock.
setStartMint() updates START_MINT.
setStartMint() updates MINT_KEEP_SEC.
mintStart parameter is assigned to START_MINT.
mintKeepMinutes parameter is multiplied by 60 and stored in MINT_KEEP_SEC.
setMintPrice() updates mintPrice.
price parameter is assigned to mintPrice.
setMaxPurchase() updates maxPurchase.
newMaxPurchase parameter is assigned to maxPurchase.
setProvenanceHash() writes PROVENANCE.
provenanceHash parameter is stored in PROVENANCE.
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
Cached balance is the amount passed to the external transfer.
supply local seeds the reserved token id range in reserveNFTs().
Loop counter drives the 30 iterations of reserveNFTs().
mintIndex local is derived from totalSupply() inside mint().
Loop counter bounds the mint iteration over numberOfTokens.
mint() assigns the current totalSupply() to mintIndex.
mint() reaches an external onERC721Received callback on a contract recipient via _safeMint.
onlyOwner modifier requires owner() == msg.sender before withdraw() body runs.
onlyOwner modifier guards reserveNFTs().
onlyOwner modifier guards setStartMint().
onlyOwner modifier guards setMintPrice().
onlyOwner modifier guards setMaxPurchase().
onlyOwner modifier guards setProvenanceHash().
onlyOwner modifier guards setBaseURI().
onlyOwner modifier guards emergencySetStartingIndexBlock().
setStartingIndex() is callable by any address, so msg.sender controls when the reveal index is fixed.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is only meaningful as the input controlling the mint() loop and arithmetic.
mintStart is only used to overwrite START_MINT inside setStartMint().
mintKeepMinutes is only used to compute MINT_KEEP_SEC inside setStartMint().
price is only used to overwrite mintPrice inside setMintPrice().
newMaxPurchase is only used to overwrite maxPurchase inside setMaxPurchase().
provenanceHash is only used to overwrite PROVENANCE inside setProvenanceHash().
baseURI is only forwarded to _setBaseURI inside setBaseURI().
The cached balance local is the exact value handed to the external transfer operation.
supply is a transient helper computed from totalSupply() inside reserveNFTs().
The loop counter is a transient helper of the reserveNFTs() mint loop.
mintIndex is a transient helper derived from totalSupply() inside mint().
The mint loop counter is a transient helper of mint().
